integrity: A local-rule proof supplies all-size descent and a transfer-walk determinant; finite code is a reproducibility cross-check and is not offered as an infinite proof. Originality rests on qualified comparison, not certification.
scientific_limitations: Vertically dead two-row B3/S23 strips and finite-support infinite two-row strips only; finite cyclic circumferences at least three; convergence bound not asserted optimal; other boundary conditions, infinite-support initial states and arbitrary two-dimensional Life not covered; previous historical literature potentially incomplete.
title: No oscillators on the two-row Conway Life cylinder: a strict descent potential and exact still-life spectrum
